---
format: html
execute:
  freeze: false
resources:
  - "cv.pdf"
  - "images/cv-page-*.png"
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# 1. Load library and define paths
library(pdftools)

pdf_path <- "cv.pdf"
img_dir <- "images"

# Ensure output directory exists
if (!dir.exists(img_dir)) {
  dir.create(img_dir)
}

# 2. Get number of pages and set up filenames
num_pages <- pdf_info(pdf_path)$pages
img_filenames <- sprintf("cv-page-%d.png", 1:num_pages)
img_filepaths <- file.path(img_dir, img_filenames)

# 3. Convert PDF to PNGs 
# (invisible() and verbose = FALSE keep the build logs clean)
invisible(pdf_convert(
  pdf = pdf_path, 
  format = "png", 
  dpi = 150, 
  filenames = img_filepaths,
  verbose = FALSE
))


```
